verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS, so a git merge-conflict tool is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence never mentions git, merge conflicts, or a merge tool. The bundled Vim editor is a general-purpose editor, not a dedicated multi-file conflict-resolution tool, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resolve merge conflicts across many files at once with a dedicated tool
